newsitem.title: UK: Brent date kept, sold on at August +2 cents-trade.
newsitem.headline: Brent date kept, sold on at August +2 cents-trade.

text.p: A Brent cargo loading August 13-15 was kept early from the paper chains on Tuesday and sold at August Brent +2 cents, traders said.
The deal, between a European major and a U.S. refiner was done this morning, but kept confidential until mid-afternoon.
A cargo loading 12-14 also changed hands in the morning, fetching August Brent +4 cents.
A second August 13-15 Brent was due to turn wet on Tuesday.
